Overview.Name: Pushpalatha
Overview.Goal: Preventing and reversing health issues, supporting hormonal balance, and gradual fat loss.

Early_Morning: Option 3: Warm water + small bowl curd
Meal_1_Breakfast: Option 1: Vegetable omelette (2 eggs) + small bowl curd
Option 2: Paneer bhurji (pan fried) + cooked vegetables
Meal_2_Lunch: Option 1: Plain rice (small portion) + chicken curry (pressure cooked) + vegetables
Option 2: Plain rice (small portion) + fish curry + vegetables
Option 3: Plain rice (small portion) + paneer curry + vegetables
Evening_Snack: Option 1: Puffed rice with onion and salt (dry)
Meal_3_Dinner: Option 3: Curd bowl with cooked vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Keep rice portions controlled to support PCOS and fat loss.
Avoid frequent fried foods; use pan fried or pressure cooked meals.
Since social gatherings trigger overeating, eat a protein-rich meal before attending.
For sweet and savory cravings, have curd or boiled eggs first and wait 10 minutes.
Maintain regular meal timing to support hormonal balance.
Focus on consistency rather than strict dieting.
